persona: Instrumentation engineer turned plant network engineer, moving into OT security
resumeText:
Vikram Rathod | Vadodara | vikram.rathod@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Network Engineer, Narmada Process Industries, Vadodara (2020 - present)
- Configure Fortinet firewalls between the plant control network and the corporate IT network.
- Split the control network into VLANs by process area and documented every zone.
- Review firewall and IDS alerts every morning and escalate unusual traffic to the security team.
- Coordinate Windows patching for HMI and historian servers during planned shutdowns.
- Walk plant operators and shift engineers through every network change before go-live.

Instrumentation Engineer, Mahi Chemicals, Bharuch (2018 - 2020)
- Maintained Siemens S7 PLC and SCADA systems for two batch reactors.

SKILLS
Fortinet, Cisco switches, Modbus, IEC 62443

EDUCATION
BE Instrumentation and Control, L.D. College of Engineering, 2018
